integrity: The claim is a complete finite-state computation supported by two executable integer-only checkers. It is not an independent external certification or a claim to the general no-incoming-transient principle.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result only for the twelve-vertex cuboctahedral graph and synchronous tie-retaining binary neighbor majority; no generalization to all regular graphs or line graphs.
Exact integer counts depend on exhaustive, independently implemented 4096-state programs supplied with the result. Historical priority against unindexed tables remains uncertain.
title: Cuboctahedral majority dynamics: an exact basin and three-geometry oscillation census
